original_sentence: I have went to the store yesterday.
corrected_sentence: I went to the store yesterday.
mistakes: Wrong tense: with a past-time marker ("yesterday") use simple past "went", not present perfect "have gone". Also "have went" is never correct — past participle of "go" is "gone".

original_sentence: She is more taller than me.
mistakes: Double comparative: "more" + "-er" is redundant. Use either "taller" or "more tall" (and "taller" is the natural form).
"Agree" is a verb, not an adjective — don't pair it with "am". Just conjugate it directly: "I agree."

original_sentence: Can you explain me this problem?
corrected_sentence: Can you explain this problem to me?
mistakes: "Explain" takes the pattern "explain something to someone" — you can't put the indirect object directly after the verb the way you can with "tell" or "give".
